sentences.ar: زمان، كان في رجال طيب اسمه أبو حسن.
sentences.en: Long ago, there was a kind man named Abu Hasan.

words.caphi_raw: t. a y y i b

sentences.ar: مرة، ضاق حاله، ودان مصاري من جاره.
sentences.en: Once, times got hard, and he borrowed money from his neighbor.

words.caphi_raw: m a s. aa r i

sentences.ar: الجار عطاه بدون تردد، وقال: خذ وقتك.
sentences.en: The neighbor gave it without hesitation, and said: take your time.

words.caphi_raw: t r a d d a d

sentences.ar: أبو حسن اشتغل ليل نهار عشان يرد الدين.
sentences.en: Abu Hasan worked day and night to repay the debt.

words.caphi_raw: 2 i sh t a gh i l

sentences.ar: كل ما يجمع شوي، كان يصير في حاجة تصرفه.
sentences.en: Every time he saved a little, some need would spend it.

words.caphi_raw: t a s. a r r u f

sentences.ar: بس هو ما نسي دينه أبدا.
sentences.en: But he never forgot his debt.
After a year, he gathered the full amount.

words.caphi_raw: m b a l l i gh

sentences.en: He went to his neighbor, and handed him the money.

words.caphi_raw: m a s. aa r i

sentences.ar: الجار رفض، وقال: أنا سامحتك من زمان.
sentences.en: The neighbor refused, and said: I forgave you long ago.

sentences.ar: أبو حسن قال: لأ، الدين دين، ولازم يترد.
sentences.en: Abu Hasan said: no, a debt is a debt, and it must be repaid.
The neighbor was moved by his honesty and integrity.

sentences.ar: أخذ المصاري، بس رجعله نصها هدية.
sentences.en: He took the money, but gave him back half as a gift.

h a d i y y e

sentences.en: He said: this is a reward for your integrity.
From that day, they became the best of friends.

sentences.ar: والحارة كلها حكت عن أمانة أبو حسن.
sentences.en: And the whole neighborhood spoke of Abu Hasan's integrity.
